Admin routes of the geo module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/geo/ai-readiness

Get AI-readiness score across active products

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## POST /v1/admin/geo/products/{productId}/faqs/accept

Accept FAQ suggestions as product FAQs

Parameters:

- `productId` in path (string, required).

Request body: [AcceptFaqSuggestionsDto](#acceptfaqsuggestionsdto).

Responses:

- `201`: no description.

## GET /v1/admin/geo/products/{productId}/faqs/suggestions

Get generic FAQ suggestions for a product

Parameters:

- `productId` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## Schemas

### AcceptFaqSuggestionsDto

- `faqs` (array of [FaqItemDto](#faqitemdto), required).

### FaqItemDto

- `question` (object, required).
- `answer` (object, required).
- `sortOrder` (number, min 0, optional).
